description: STARTER DATA, to be checked: words that tell what a custom place type of YOUR tree is, so that the addon can learn the types from the tree (it reads only the types that places use). A type is recognised when its text, folded (case, accents, spaces, dashes, quotes), is one of the words of a group. 'role': province, empire and monarchy (the custom type of the tree for them), district and canton (types that are areas; the words of a group also become a rule: an answer that calls a level by one of them gets the type of your tree), settlement (types that are settlements, not areas). A group may say "builtin": the number of the type of Gramps that the engine gives its words (district is 12): a rule is then made from a custom type of your tree only when more places use it than that type of Gramps. A group is a set of synonyms: words that mean different units (jaras, kerulet) are in groups of their own, so that they are never joined. Add your own words (any language) in ~/.config/placecompleter/type-vocabulary.json (or PLACECOMPLETER_VOCABULARY): its groups are added to these; an update of the addon does not touch it.
